facts.value: The Student Contribution Fee is in principle allowable for tax relief.
With effect from 2011, the first €2,000 in qualifying fees per claim will be ineligible for tax relief for students in full-time education.
With effect from 2011, the first €1,000 in qualifying fees per claim will be ineligible for tax relief for students in part-time education.
Families with two or more children who are paying the Student Contribution Fee charge will qualify for tax relief in respect of payments being made for second and subsequent children.
The upper threshold for tax relief on qualifying fees per programme is €7,000.
For further details on the tax relief please refer to the Revenue Commissioners.
All students attending Erasmus/Exchange/Cooperative Education programmes must pay fees as normal to the University of Limerick.
